name: open30_momentum

rules.signal: mv = close of 10:00 bar - open of 09:30 bar
rules.direction: long if mv>0 else short; skip day if |mv|<20
rules.exit: close of 15:59 bar, no stop, no target

costs.slippage: 1 tick (0.25) on entry and on exit

pass_rule: final PF>=1.2 and best month < 50% of net
